name: base
title: Shared base: menu, layer, dialog, button, chip, surfaces
entry: openMenu, menuKeydown, dismissable, syncModal, backdropClick, whenShut; and the recipes in #ui/styles.css
description: What every screen and every sibling plugin builds its controls from, built once with every state and keyboard path (UI_01). The menu: a role=menu list of menuitem rows with the WAI-ARIA keys (Up and Down wrap, Home and End, Esc closes with focus back, Tab closes and moves on), a press outside closing it, its opener's aria-expanded, its first enabled row focused. The dismissable layer: Esc and a press (or only a click) outside close a menu, popover or tip, heard first in the capture phase, only while it is open; only Esc gives focus back. The modal dialog: a native <dialog> shown modal from the state that wants it (the browser keeps focus in it and gives it back on close), a click on its backdrop closing it like Cancel, its close event taken only while it is still shut. The recipes: the button, the chip, the menu's rows, the popover and panel surfaces, the dialog's parts, a key, code, visually hidden words, the focus ring, and the board's own baseline in any host's page (root.css).

files.core: menu-core.ts (menuStep), layer-core.ts (focusBackOn, isClick), dialog-core.ts (modalStep, onBackdrop): pure, no DOM
files.browser: menu.ts (menuKeydown, openMenu, menuItems, firstItem), layer.ts (dismissable), dialog.ts (syncModal, backdropClick, whenShut): framework-free, nothing touches the DOM at import
files.styles: root.css (.vb-board, the board's scope [class*='vb-'], box-sizing, [hidden], the host guard for h1-h3, p, button, input, select, textarea, dialog), a11y.css (focus ring, visually hidden), text.css (kbd, code), surface.css (popover and panel), button.css, chip.css, menu.css, dialog.css; first in #ui/styles.css; tokens only

parts.vb-btn: a text button (vb-btn-primary: the one primary action; vb-btn-small); aria-pressed draws it on, aria-busy busy, disabled muted
parts.vb-select: a select beside the buttons, in their look
parts.vb-chip: a pill of words or a count; data-tone agent | answered | later | new; vb-chip-btn when it is a button
parts.vb-menu-list: the role=menu list on the popover surface, hung under its opener's right edge; a page that places it moves it
parts.vb-menu-item: a row: its icon, vb-menu-label (cut with an ellipsis), vb-menu-check (a menuitemcheckbox's tick), its kbd
parts.vb-dialog: the panel surface of a <dialog> (or a sample div): h2, vb-dialog-item, vb-field + vb-input or a textarea, vb-dialog-problem, vb-dialog-hint, vb-dialog-actions
parts.vb-board: the root a host mounts the board in: its type, ink and the vb-board container

methods.openMenu({ menu, opener?, within?, key?,: a menu the caller drew open: its keys, a press outside, aria-expanded, first row focused; returns { close(focusBack?) }
methods.menuKeydown(e, items, close, { back?, st: the keys alone, for a menu that hears its keys itself
methods.dismissable({ within, dismiss, escape?,: listen for Esc and a press or click outside; returns the stop
methods.syncModal(dialog, wants, opened?): show the dialog modal or close it, following its state
methods.backdropClick(close): a click handler: a click on the backdrop closes it
methods.whenShut(shut): a close-event handler taken only while the dialog is still shut

whenToUse: Any menu, popover, tip or dialog on the board or in a sibling plugin; any text button, chip or key; anything focusable.
whenNotToUse: A native select's list (MenuSelect: the browser's own keys), a pattern's own control with a look of its own (a card's quick actions, the layout row), or the image viewer's dialog (its own open and close motion).
accessibility: The WAI-ARIA menu pattern: role=menu and menuitem rows, roving focus by the keys, Esc gives focus back to the opener, Tab moves on; the opener carries aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls. Dialogs are native and modal: focus stays inside, the rest of the page is inert, focus goes back on close; each has a name (aria-labelledby) and a description. The focus ring is the decoration tier (Lc 30) in light and dark; every button keeps a visible label or a name.
